label.en: big beat breakbeat with punk energy

bricks.description: big beat breakbeat with punk energy
bricks.when: When the track should hit like a riot on a dancefloor.

explanation.en: Breakbeat dance music played with the attitude of a punk band.

bricks.when: For a beat that feels aggressive rather than polite.

explanation.en: Sampled drum breaks cut up and driven hard, the kick clipping on purpose.

label.en: acid synth riffs and gritty rave stabs

bricks.description: acid synth riffs and gritty rave stabs
bricks.when: When the hook should be a sound, not a melody.

explanation.en: A squelching resonant synth line and short dirty chord hits.
explanation.ru: Хлюпающая резонансная линия синта и короткие грязные аккорды.

bricks.when: For a chant the listener shouts back.

explanation.en: Short phrases barked rather than sung, repeated as hooks.
explanation.ru: Короткие фразы, выкрикнутые, а не спетые, повторяются как хуки.

label.en: siren risers into a breakbeat drop

bricks.description: siren risers into a breakbeat drop
bricks.when: Before the biggest moment of the track.

explanation.en: Rising alarm-like synths that build tension and fall into the beat.
explanation.ru: Нарастающие синты-сирены, которые накаляют и обрываются в бит.
